stripe-alt.displayName: Stripe Alt, overlay (7.5% paper, inline value)

display.purpose: Boss meter total and personal DPS number; the personal number scales clamp(16px, 8.5cqw, 34px), clock and timer digits fill their tile via container units.

headline.purpose: Secondary scorebug numbers, gear stat values, pickup count and refine level (19-22px).

title.purpose: The solid channel tag naming each element; lower-third banners step up to 15px at .12em.

data.purpose: Row values: DPS, damage, timers, resource numbers (15-16px); 600 weight for the de-emphasised half of a pair.

body.purpose: Help text and stat labels (11-12px), max 34rem.

name.purpose: Player, skill, item and boss names on one ellipsised line (12-15px).

label.purpose: Units, captions, empty and waiting states; uppercase at .04-.08em.

window-display.purpose: Stat tile numbers in the windows (26px).

window-heading.purpose: Window and dialog headings (22px), launcher tile, timer panel and Settings section names (20px); name headings use Atkinson 800 at 20-26px instead.

window-total.purpose: Summary totals over tables (22px; 18px in boss fight detail and Rewards totals), item counters, attributes.

window-tag.purpose: Section heads drawn as channel tags inside windows (14px).

window-row.purpose: Table cells and row values (15px, 600-700); Boss Timers countdown 17px.

window-name.purpose: Name cells and row headers in window tables (Atkinson 700, 13px).

window-body.purpose: Window root text 13px; help, banners and descriptions 12px.

window-label.purpose: Column heads, field labels, tile captions, chart axes (12px, .07em, uppercase).

shadows.name: channel-edge
shadows.purpose: Top lip of every plate in its channel colour.

shadows.name: lower-third-lift
shadows.purpose: Pickup and drop cards floating over other plates.

shadows.name: edit-lift
shadows.purpose: Plates while the overlay is unlocked for editing.

shadows.name: alarm-frame
shadows.purpose: A plate in a warning state; gold for caution.

shadows.name: text-halo
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on paper text over plates; removed on solid fills.

shadows.name: channel-lip
shadows.purpose: Top edge of floating parts, launcher tiles and banners (rule-strong, gold or flame by kind).

shadows.name: channel-underline
shadows.purpose: Titlebar strip, active toggles, selected rows and options, focused wells.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused input wells; resting wells use inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals: lower-third wipes and alert flashes.

motion.name: lower-third-in
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0), .26-.32s ease-out, once
motion.purpose: New pickup, drop and toast cards wipe in from their tag outward.

motion.name: warning-flash
motion.purpose: Alerts flash twice on arrival, then hold; never loop.

motion.name: window-state
motion.purpose: Window button, chip and icon-button hover and press; launcher tiles .18s.

shapes.stripCut: 6px on thin strips (health, mana, XP, weight, clock, timer)
shapes.tagSlant: 5-8px trailing slant on tags, banners, timer modes and the lock pill
shapes.controls: 16px square checkbox wells, diamond radios, 10x18px range bar thumb on a 4px track, 9px status squares, square scrollbars
shapes.windowIcons: packages/ui-kit/icons.tsx, same 2px stroke grid; select chevron and checkbox tick drawn in it

layout.responsive: No viewport breakpoints; plates respond to their own size via container queries (cqw, cqh).
layout.windowChrome: 40px titlebar; content pads 14px 16px (Settings 14px 18px beside a 160px rundown)
layout.windowMin: Each window declares a minimum size, 560x420 (Settings) to 820x560 (Build Export)
layout.windowGroups: Joined parts at 2px; separate plates 8-12px apart; launcher board five columns at 8px, tiles min 92px

channels.launcherTiles: each tile takes its tool's channel

boundaries: packages/companion/src/renderer/index.css is Buh's Vale Companion (third-party, credited): only its :root base colours and UI face are mapped onto the palette; its layout and components (including its eyebrow and kicker labels) are not part of this system.
The overlay links theme.css, so its inspector's checkboxes and ranges take the theme's square controls; the overlay's own tokens (paper-3 .52, stripe .045, inline stripe-alt .075) are unchanged.

components.name: Plate with Title Tag
components.description: The ink plate every element is drawn on: square, top-right corner cut, teal channel edge, named by a solid channel tag.
components.html:
Encounter DPS

Content sits 10px under the tag.
components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-plate{position:relative;width:280px;padding:12px 12px 10px;background:rgb(12 18 24 / .76);color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 2px rgb(12 18 24 / .95),0 1px 3px rgb(12 18 24 / .85);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--teal) 55%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 10px) 0,100% 10px,100% 100%,0 100%);} .ds-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px 2px 7px;background:var(--teal);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:none;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%);} .ds-tag{margin:0 0 10px;} .ds-plate-body{margin:0;color:var(--paper-2);}

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-plate{position:relative;width:280px;padding:12px 12px 10px;background:rgb(12 18 24 / .76);color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 2px rgb(12 18 24 / .95),0 1px 3px rgb(12 18 24 / .85);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--teal) 55%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 10px) 0,100% 10px,100% 100%,0 100%);} .ds-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 12px 2px 7px;background:var(--teal);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:none;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%);} .ds-bug{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px 8px;flex-wrap:wrap;} .ds-num{font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:30px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;} .ds-details{display:flex;gap:4px 16px;margin-top:10px;color:var(--paper-2);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;} .ds-details>span{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:row-reverse;align-items:baseline;gap:5px;} .ds-details strong{color:var(--paper);font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em;text-transform:none;}

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-plate{position:relative;width:280px;padding:12px 12px 10px;background:rgb(12 18 24 / .76);color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 2px rgb(12 18 24 / .95),0 1px 3px rgb(12 18 24 / .85);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--teal) 55%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 10px) 0,100% 10px,100% 100%,0 100%);} .ds-ranking{display:grid;gap:2px;} .ds-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:30px;padding:3px 8px 3px 4px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--stripe);} .ds-row:nth-child(even){background:rgba(244,247,250,.075);} .ds-row::before{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:var(--fill);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 52%,transparent);box-shadow:inset -2px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 70%,white);content:'';} .ds-row>*{position:relative;z-index:1;} .ds-player{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-width:0;} .ds-rank{width:2ch;color:var(--paper-2);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:15px;font-weight:800;text-align:right;} .ds-name{font-weight:700;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;} .ds-val{font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;}

components.name: Resource Bar
components.description: A thin strip with a flat fill, bright cap and ten ink-hairline segments.
components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-strip{width:320px;height:28px;background:rgb(12 18 24 / .76);color:var(--paper);text-shadow:0 0 2px rgb(12 18 24 / .95),0 1px 3px rgb(12 18 24 / .85);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 6px) 0,100% 6px,100% 100%,0 100%);} .ds-res{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:8px;height:100%;padding:0 8px;overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;} .ds-res::before{position:absolute;inset:0;transform:scaleX(var(--fill));transform-origin:left center;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 78%,transparent);box-shadow:inset -3px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,white);content:'';transition:transform 120ms linear;} .ds-res::after{position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 calc(10% - 1px),rgb(12 18 24 / .55) calc(10% - 1px) 10%);content:'';} .ds-res>*{position:relative;z-index:1;} .ds-res-label{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;} .ds-res-num{text-align:right;} .ds-res-num span{color:var(--paper-2);font-weight:600;}

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-status{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;width:36px;color:var(--paper);text-shadow:0 0 2px rgb(12 18 24 / .95),0 1px 3px rgb(12 18 24 / .85);} .ds-frame{position:relative;width:36px;height:36px;background:#1f5a4e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(244,247,250,.22);} .ds-veil{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;background:rgb(12 18 24 / .66);} .ds-stacks{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;padding:0 3px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;text-shadow:none;} .ds-bar{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:3px;background:rgba(244,247,250,.16);} .ds-bar::before{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--teal);content:'';transform:scaleX(.65);transform-origin:left;} .ds-left{font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;}

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} @keyframes ds-wipe{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}} .ds-drop{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:260px;color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font-ui);text-shadow:0 0 2px rgb(12 18 24 / .95),0 1px 3px rgb(12 18 24 / .85);} .ds-banner{align-self:flex-start;padding:4px 16px 3px 10px;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:none;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0 100%);animation:ds-wipe .26s var(--ease-out) both;} .ds-card{padding:10px 12px 11px;background:rgb(12 18 24 / .92);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45);animation:ds-wipe .32s var(--ease-out) .08s both;} .ds-card-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding-bottom:8px;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--rule);} .ds-card-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;} .ds-slot{align-self:flex-start;padding:2px 10px 1px 6px;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:none;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 5px) 100%,0 100%);} .ds-stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:8px;} .ds-stat span{color:var(--paper-2);font-size:12px;} .ds-stat strong{font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:19px;font-weight:800;} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-banner,.ds-card{animation:none}}

components.name: Quiet Button

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-quiet{padding:2px 9px 1px;border:0;background:rgba(244,247,250,.1);color:var(--paper-2);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;} .ds-quiet:hover{background:var(--teal);color:var(--ink);} .ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--paper);outline-offset:2px;}

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-lock{padding:9px 18px 8px;border:0;background:var(--teal);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0 100%);} .ds-lock:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--teal) 82%,white);} .ds-lock:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--paper);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Region Tabs

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.52);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.045);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--hp:#e5484d;--mp:#2f6fe0;--violet:#9b6cff;--team-1:#3d8bff;--team-2:#ff4f8b;--team-3:#e04ef0;--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;} .ds-tab{padding:2px 9px 1px;background:rgba(244,247,250,.1);color:var(--paper-2);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;} .ds-tab.is-active{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);} .ds-tab.is-window{color:var(--gold);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--gold);} .ds-tab.is-expired{color:var(--flame);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--flame);}

components.name: Window Titlebar

components.css: :host{--ink:#0c1218;--ink-deep:#080c10;--plate:#121a22;--plate-raised:#19232d;--plate-high:#212c37;--paper:#f4f7fa;--paper-2:rgba(244,247,250,.74);--paper-3:rgba(244,247,250,.55);--rule:rgba(244,247,250,.14);--rule-strong:rgba(244,247,250,.3);--stripe:rgba(244,247,250,.035);--stripe-alt:rgba(244,247,250,.07);--teal:#00c2a8;--flame:#ff5a36;--gold:#ffc145;--channel:var(--flame);--font-num:'Barlow Condensed','Bahnschrift SemiCondensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--font-ui:'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-titlebar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:420px;height:40px;padding-left:12px;background:var(--ink-deep);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--channel);} .ds-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font-num);font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;} .ds-brand-tag{padding:3px 12px 2px 7px;background:var(--channel);color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.1;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%);} .ds-controls{display:flex;align-self:stretch;margin-left:auto;padding-bottom:2px;} .ds-icon{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:40px;padding:0 10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--paper-2);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s var(--ease-out),color .15s var(--ease-out);} .ds-icon:hover{background:var(--stripe-alt);color:var(--paper);} .ds-close:hover{background:var(--flame);color:var(--ink);} .ds-icon:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--channel);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a stream graphic: a scorebug, a stat bug, a standings table, a lower-third. Each is cut from a solid ink plate with one 45-degree corner clipped away, named by a small solid tag in the colour of the channel it speaks on, and filled with heavy condensed numerals over legible names. A viewer reads it the way they read a match: tag, number, order, then back to the action. The world deliberately refuses the dark, rounded, translucent meter-panel stack that DPS addons ship.

Density is high and flat. Plates carry no rounded corners, no gradients of tone, no glass. Data sits in alternating striped bands; meters are flat fills with a bright leading cap; time is drawn as length. Colour is a channel, never a decoration: teal is the broadcast's own voice, flame is threat, gold is loot and value, and five team colours say only who.

The world has two surfaces. The in-game overlay (`packages/overlay`) is the on-air package: translucent ink plates over the game scene, sized and placed by the player. The tool windows (launcher, Settings, Combat with its analysis detail, death log and session picker, Rewards with its catalog, Character, Boss Timers, Build Export, and the Companion window's chrome) are the studio desk behind it: the same plates, tags, stripes and faces, set opaque on a stepped ink desk from the shared window theme (`packages/ui-kit/theme.css`), with a larger type ramp for reading at a desk. Each window speaks on one tool channel, set on `:root`. The Companion window's inner pages are Buh's Vale Companion, a credited third-party app; only its base colours and interface face are mapped onto this palette, and its layout and components are not part of this system.
keyCharacteristics: Square ink plates, one corner cut; on the overlay, alpha set by the player's per-element opacity; in the windows, opaque steps of the desk.
Titles as solid channel-colour tags with a slanted trailing end.
Barlow Condensed for every number and label; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for names and sentences.
Striped rows, flat fills with a bright cap, ten-segment gauges.
One channel per tool window, carried by the titlebar underline, tags, plate lips, active chips, focus and charts.
Motion only on arrival: a lower-third wipe or a two-beat flash, then stillness.

rules.name: The Channel Rule
rules.body: Every plate speaks on exactly one channel, set once per element (`--channel`), and its tag, top edge, chart line, time bars and active tab all take that colour. Never mix two channels' tags on one plate.

rules.name: The One-Tool-One-Channel Rule
rules.body: Each window sets its tool's channel on `:root` (launcher, Combat, analysis detail and session picker teal; Rewards and catalog gold; Character sky; Boss Timers and death log flame; Build Export lime; Companion violet; Settings paper), and each launcher tile takes the channel of the tool it opens. A window's titlebar underline, brand tag, primary button, active chips, focus outline, selection and charts all follow it; state colours (flame error, gold warning, lime ok) stay fixed.

rules.name: The Who-Only Rule
rules.body: Team colours say only which player a row is; they never mean threat, loot or value, and channel colours never fill a player's row.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Colour Rule
rules.body: Text set on a solid channel or team fill is ink and loses the text halo; text set on ink is paper and keeps it. User-chosen loot rule colours pick ink or white by luminance.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Condensed Rule
rules.body: Every numeral is Barlow Condensed and tabular; every name is Atkinson. A number set in Atkinson or a name set in Barlow uppercase is wrong.

rules.name: The Halo Rule
rules.body: Paper text on an overlay plate carries a tight two-layer ink halo (`0 0 2px` at .95, `0 1px 3px` at .85) so it survives any game scene at any plate opacity. Window text sits on opaque ink and goes without, except over a share fill (the Combat meter rows keep a lighter halo).

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: A plate at rest has no outer shadow; lift is reserved for cards that arrive over others, for edit mode, and for dialogs and menus that float over a window.

rules.name: The Lip-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Edges are drawn as inset lips, rings and underlines in the channel or rule colour, never as outer borders; the window outline itself is an inset 1px rule.

dos: **Do** cut every plate from ink at the player's opacity, square with the top-right 45-degree cut (10px; 6px on thin strips).
**Do** name every element with a solid channel tag, ink letters, slanted trailing end.
**Do** set every number in Barlow Condensed, tabular; set every name in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.
**Do** draw time and share as length: fills, time bars and veils, not percentages alone.
**Do** keep the two-layer ink halo on paper text over plates, and drop it on solid colour fills.
**Do** animate only on arrival: one lower-third wipe or a two-beat flash that then holds; honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by showing the end state.
**Do** set a new window's tool channel once on `:root` and build it from the shared theme's tokens and components; no raw hex outside `packages/ui-kit/theme.css`.
**Do** use the window ramp (20-22px headings, 18-22px totals, 15px row values, 12px labels) in windows and the overlay ramp on the overlay.
**Do** draw window icons from `packages/ui-kit/icons.tsx`: 2px square-capped strokes on the 16px grid in the text colour.
donts: **Don't** round corners; the minimap radar is the only circle.
**Don't** use smooth tonal gradients or glass blur on plates; repeating gradients are for stripes, segments, empty states and hazard bands only.
**Don't** loop any animation during play; nothing keeps blinking during a fight.
**Don't** use a team colour to mean anything but who, or a channel colour to fill a player's row.
**Don't** use text glyphs or emoji as icons; draw them as 2px square-capped strokes on the 16px grid, or use the game's own rasters.
**Don't** add hard offset shadows; lift is soft and ambient, and only for floating cards, edit mode, and dialogs and menus.
**Don't** take the Companion pages' layout, eyebrows or components as a pattern for our windows; they are Buh's.
